data.rationale: The proposal gets the overall flow right: the GitHub search, profile and repo lookup, and the email subject and body templates. It falls short in four ways: the blog step is vague (no {blog} parameter or new-tab step), the fixed address hiring@example.com is turned into a parameter, values read off the page (followers, stars, language and so on) are listed as inputs, and the last step says Send instead of Discard, which is a serious mistake for an automation.
